pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   C. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

5. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

8. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   C. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Folding as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.

10. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   B. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   C. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

12. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   B. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. A — Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A — Plan income and spending wisely

12. C — Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. (4 marks)
